mismatch.message: unsupported hero command: an unported branch of this command: picking a lock requires D_TRAPPED door trap in doopen_indir()

summary: The first mismatch is the trapped-door success arm of lock.c:doopen_indir(). At step 37, #open targets a closed D_TRAPPED door and C passes the strength roll; it calls b_trapped("door", FINGER), sets the door to D_NODOOR, and refreshes vision. JavaScript throws before these effects. The existing b_trapped() port is available, but shop-door add_damage() remains unported. Whole-function scope also includes the separate AUTOUNLOCK_KICK branch that currently throws.

source.branch: doopen_indir() targets a real closed door with D_TRAPPED after passing the hands, pit, mimic, and size checks, and rnl(20) is below (ACURRSTR + ACURR(A_DEX) + ACURR(A_CON)) / 3. The recorded #open command reaches this arm at step 37. The same whole function also contains an AUTOUNLOCK_KICK path for an already locked door when that flag is enabled.
callers: lock.c:doopen() dispatches the #open command and calls doopen_indir(0, 0).
hack.c:test_move() calls doopen_indir(x, y) for automatic opening while walking into a closed door.
dependencies: trap.c:b_trapped() performs the trapped-door explosion; its JavaScript port is js/trap.js:b_trapped().
hack.c:in_rooms() determines whether the door is in a shop and therefore gates shop damage.
shk.c:add_damage() accounts for shop-door damage and is still unported; its return is discarded.

evidence: C source at nethack-c/upstream/src/lock.c:780-921 shows the entire doopen_indir() unit. Its success arm at lines 904-916 calls b_trapped("door", FINGER) when D_TRAPPED is set, then changes the mask to D_NODOOR, conditionally calls add_damage() for a shop, and calls feel_newsym() and recalc_block_point().
Direct callers are nethack-c/upstream/src/lock.c:773-776 (doopen() for the #open command) and nethack-c/upstream/src/hack.c:1099-1101 (test_move() automatic opening).

At the examined commit, js/lock.js:1093 onward translates doopen_indir() but its D_TRAPPED arm throws UnsupportedLockError before the trap call and subsequent door/vision updates. The same function also has an existing AUTOUNLOCK_KICK throw in its locked-door branch. js/trap.js:3504 onward already implements b_trapped(); js/lock.js:582-590 uses it for a trapped door opened through pick_lock() and records the still-unported shop add_damage() side effect.

C source nethack-c/upstream/src/trap.c:6694-6709 defines b_trapped(): it draws rnd(5 + (level < 5 ? level : 2 + level / 2)), prints the explosion, applies damage and exercises, then stuns. On this level the recording logs rnd(6)=4 at trap.c:6697.

The assigned saved evaluation challenges/evaluations/baseline-9f590c88f193a980f8f819ebfad051a65f36faa0-v29.json reports the first mismatch for this case as a stop at step 37: the unported D_TRAPPED branch in doopen_indir(). The assigned recording challenges/cases/v29/v29-open-trapped-door.session.json shows the C action at step 37 logs rnl(20)=13 at lock.c:904, then rnd(6)=4 in b_trapped(), and displays “The door opens. KABOOM!! The door was booby-trapped! You stagger...”.
